title: Wellness Membership Rate Card: Monthly Dues and Enrollment Fees
content:
Monthly dues and the one-time enrollment fee for the Wellness Membership, by tier. All amounts are in US dollars to the cent.

| Tier | Monthly dues | Enrollment fee (one time) | Enrollment fee waiver window after discharge | Enrollment fee waiver window for a former member rejoining | First partial period prorated by day | Dues held without increase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | 39.00 | 29.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |
| Aquatic Access Membership | 49.00 | 29.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | 79.00 | 49.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |
| Wellness Plus Membership | 129.00 | 49.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |
| Performance Membership | 189.00 | 49.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |
| Performance Plus Membership | 239.00 | 49.00 | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | Yes | 12 months from the start date |

## Notes to the rate card

- **Monthly dues.** The dues recorded on a membership are the dues locked at sign-up for its tier.
- **Enrollment fee.** A one-time fee: 29.00 on the Open Gym Access Membership and the Aquatic Access Membership, 49.00 on each of the other four tiers.
- **Discharge waiver window.** The number of calendar days after a discharge from therapy at the clinic within which the enrollment fee is waived: 30 on every tier.
- **Rejoin window.** The number of calendar days after a cancellation within which a former member rejoins without an enrollment fee: 90 on every tier.
- **Proration of the first partial period.** "Yes" on every tier: dues for the first partial period, up to the first billing day, are prorated by day.
- **Dues held without increase.** On every tier, monthly dues are not increased for 12 months counted from the start date.

## Reading the card (hypothetical comparison)

A prospective member weighing the Wellness Essentials Membership against the Wellness Plus Membership reads monthly dues of 79.00 and 129.00 respectively, and the same enrollment fee of 49.00 on both. The same reader comparing the Open Gym Access Membership with the Performance Plus Membership reads monthly dues of 39.00 and 239.00, and enrollment fees of 29.00 and 49.00.
